Container.Name: Tor Proxy
Container.Overview: Tor Proxy runs the Tor network daemon as a SOCKS5 proxy in a container, so other apps can route explicitly configured outbound traffic through Tor.
Container.Requires: This container has no web interface and is not a VPN. Configure each client app to use the SOCKS5 proxy explicitly, for example socks5h://UNRAID-IP:9050 or the Tor container name on a custom Docker network. Keep SOCKS Hostname set to 0.0.0.0 so Docker port publishing can reach the proxy. Exposing 9050 on your LAN lets other local clients use it, so restrict access with your network or firewall rules if needed. The Tor Data mount is optional for a simple proxy; leave it blank unless you need persistent Tor state, and make the path writable by the container if you enable it. Tor can take a short time to bootstrap after startup.

Config.Name: SOCKS5 Port
Config.Description: Tor SOCKS5 proxy port. Container port: 9050.

Config.Name: Tor Data
Config.Description: Optional persistent Tor data directory. Leave blank for the image's internal data directory. If enabled, make this path writable by the container before startup.

Config.Name: SOCKS Hostname
Config.Description: Interface Tor listens on inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 for Unraid bridge networking and other containers.

Config.Name: SOCKS Port
Config.Description: SOCKS port Tor listens on inside the container. Keep this aligned with the container port mapping.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Tor data directory inside the container. Keep this pointed at the Tor Data mount.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Tor log level, for example err, warn, notice, info, or debug.

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Enable wrapper debug output for troubleshooting. Use true or false.

Config.Name: Set Permissions
Config.Description: Allow the container wrapper to chown/chmod the Tor data directory at startup. Keep false on Unraid if you see Operation not permitted on /var/lib/tor.

Config.Name: Torrc Append
Config.Description: Optional raw torrc lines appended to the generated configuration. Use for advanced relay, bridge, onion service, or isolation settings only after checking Tor documentation.
